scope: Independent source review of Learn source13 native geometry, bounded cache use, invalidation/lifecycle and prepared real-input regression. No tests, browser, build, profiling or product/test edits by this reviewer.
reviewedInvariants: Capture stores Learn actual positive finite union rectangles in content coordinates; it does not apply Test caret width/height clamps. Zero-width/unusable captures keep the original native Learn geometry path.

Cached neutral values pass through the unchanged learningCaretGeometry formula, preserving native fractional dimensions, minimum2px display width, all4 caret styles, RTL line offset and the existing +1px row tolerance/fontSize*1.85 scroll rule.

The shared cache admits only exact correct ASCII prose prefixes and contiguous verified target identities, bounded128 anchors and complete words<=64; errors/extras/replacements/deletions/unsupported text cannot silently use an old map.

The latest incorrect or non-keyboard attempt invalidates capture whenever measurement runs. A rejected stop-on-error attempt that leaves the displayed prefix unchanged does not change glyph geometry; its attempts and timing remain canonical.

Composition start explicitly invalidates; active composition and committed non-keyboard evidence keep native fallback. Deletion is independently caught by the cache transition rule even when the last insertion-attempt batch is empty.

Controller, focus, status, completion, target, font size/family, direction and composition changes are represented in lifecycle/state invalidation. Same-text restarts do not inherit old controller boxes.

Own stage scroll retains content-coordinate boxes and resets desired-scroll bookkeeping on unexpected user scroll. Font loadingdone/loadingerror, root style/class/theme, resize and visual viewport changes invalidate and measure. Observer/font ownership remains stable and cleanup detaches/guards callbacks.

The stable empty passage marker is layout-equivalent; the pace callback remains enabled only when requested and changes with its actual visible position/status. No learning, correction, attempt, timing or score path was replaced.
